prompt:
Create one polished, high-fidelity landscape desktop web application screenshot (1440x960, no browser chrome) of the category-standard product catalogue CRUD interface. This is the familiar baseline option, executed with unusually clear hierarchy and excellent craft. It must be a real interface, not a poster, concept art, collage, or promotional site. No photos, no logos, no invented claims, IDs, dates, counts, metrics, rows, stock values, categories, or fields.

Use the expected clean inventory dashboard grammar: white and very light neutral surfaces, dark readable text, a straightforward medium blue action accent, simple table, direct search and category dropdown, conventional edit form, and a document preview. Sans-serif UI typography, monospaced JSON, restrained lines, 8–12px corners. No signature metaphor or unusual material. Keep it familiar, direct, and exceptionally well arranged.

Header: “Product catalogue”, “Sample data”, and blue “Add product”. The main work area is a precise two-column layout: searchable product table at left (48%) and selected product form/document inspector at right (52%). Include labeled Search and Category controls. Show exactly these product rows and their exact values:
Samsung Galaxy A15 | Phones | ZMW 2,800 | Stock 14 | In stock
Tecno Spark 20 | Phones | ZMW 2,100 | Stock 22 | In stock
iPhone 13 | Phones | ZMW 11,500 | Stock 4 | Low stock
Cotton T-Shirt | Clothing | ZMW 150 | Stock 60 | In stock
Select Samsung Galaxy A15. Do not include other rows or counts.

Show an editable form with exact labels and values: Name Samsung Galaxy A15; Category Phones; Price (ZMW) 2800; Stock 14; Tags android and budget; Specs storage 128GB, ram 4GB, battery 5000mAh. Show Save product, Cancel, Delete. Under it, show “MongoDB document” followed by a readable nested JSON object with exactly the fields name, category, price, stock, tags, specs and the same exact values. Do not include an ObjectId or timestamp. Keep the whole interface clean, conventional, accessible, and easy to scan.
